tools.name: scan_token
tools.description: Fast rug/scam check for any Solana or EVM token by contract address (1–3 s, no AI cost). Returns a CLEAN / CAUTION / RISKY verdict with plain-language reasons, contract checks (mint & freeze authority, LP lock, honeypot, buy/sell tax, top holder, RugCheck or GoPlus risk score) and live market data (

tools.name: analyze_token
tools.description: Slower, deeper report (10–40 s) written by ARC AI's model: overall score, scam probability, risk/hype/whale scores, narrative tags, section-by-section analysis and holder/developer data. Prefer scan_token for a quick safety check; rate-limited to about 15 per minute.

tools.name: get_signals
tools.description: Latest signals from ARC AI's six agents: verified whale trades, Sentinel rug warnings, Hunter launch picks, momentum and narrative calls. Newest first.

tools.name: get_whale_flows
tools.description: Verified on-chain whale trades ($10K+ DEX swaps) in the last 24h, combined per coin: buys vs sells in USD, net flow, number of wallets, plus the most active whale wallets. Optionally narrow to one coin by ticker or contract address.

tools.name: get_launches
tools.description: New Solana tokens (under 7 days old, $10K+ liquidity) with an activity score, RugCheck safety label (safe / caution / risky), suspicious-volume flag (likely wash trading), liquidity, 24h volume and trades.

tools.name: get_track_record
tools.description: How often ARC AI's agents were right: graded BUY / SELL / rug-warning calls over the last 30 days per agent, plus recent calls with the evidence each was graded on. Use it to decide how much weight to give a signal.

tools.name: get_coin
tools.description: Price and 24h change for a coin plus ARC AI's own data on it: 24h whale buys/sells, the latest call from each agent (with that agent's graded accuracy) and its ARC AI listing score if listed.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search ARC AI for a coin or project by name or ticker: listed projects, tracked tokens with prices, published AI reports and news stories.

tools.name: get_news
tools.description: Latest ARC AI market news stories (title, summary, coin, link). Stories include ARC AI's own whale and agent data where available.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
